official_definition: Count Break: X (When Attacks) By -X counters (send X cores from your Counter Area to the Void), [additional effects]. Count Break can only be used once per game.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Count Break] or [Count Break: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Count Break]", "give [Count Break]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
